notes.title: Update is live!
notes.content:
We just merged the beta branch into the public one with the fixes we posted yesterday. We tested the game several times and found no problems. I hope you will have a smooth experience.  As always let us know of any feedback and we will fix any issues as fast as we can. Enjoy Oblivion : ) and thank you for your continued support.

Some of the bigger fixes are:

-Fixed fps dependent speed with smooth locomotion.

-Fixed telekinesis and smooth locomotion. Before, using telekinesis while having smooth locomotion caused it to move you forward as you moved objects. Now this is fixed, when holding an object with your left hand you will not propel forward as well.

-Fixed audio problems with some enemies.

-Fixed smooth locomotion restarting after tutorials, etc. Now it should be seamless and not require you to activate it again after cinematics or tutorials (only after changing whole levels).

-Fixed a possible serious bug that would (very rarely) cause players to skip whole sections of the game (such as the forest and some puzzles).

notes.title: RUNES HAS A NEW GAME ART!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28663494/e2fd4606b6397c7e4dee6097c5e1971db65e6866.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

[b]Today is a great day! [/b]

As we're getting [b]closer and closer to release[/b], the time has finally come for us to unveil the [b]new key art for Runes: The Forgotten Path[/b].
We have been working on it for a while and here we are!

[b]Why[/b] a new key art? Simply put: we really enjoyed the old one, but we felt it didn't represent how [b]Runes has evolved overtime[/b].
We decided to create a [b]new cover[/b] that could convey the sense of [b]adventure, action and epicness[/b] we put inside our game.

It also comes with a whole new set of screenshots int the store! 

We really hope you enjoy it as much as we enjoyed creating it.
